svg.title: Five ways to keep and read earlier context
svg.desc: Six rows. Full attention stores and reads all 12 cells. SWA stores and reads only the last 4. Linear attention keeps no per-token KV and rewrites one 4×4 state S. Sparse selection stores 12 cells and 12 search keys and reads 4 cells picked by scoring the keys. Compression stores 6 entries of 2 tokens. Cross-layer sharing stores 12 cells in layer A only, and layer B reads them.
